lessons.text: Baseline: val_loss 0.1838 in 2719 steps at 11.48M params (exp 0)
Exp 1's cosine schedule was inverted (LR rose from 0 to peak), a bug; its +7% says nothing about cosine decay (exp 1, human review)
Widening DiT from 256 to 384 hidden dim regresses val_loss by ~1.5% in 2-min runs; fewer steps (1525 vs 2719) outweigh capacity (exp 2)
A correct cosine warmdown over the last 30% matched the linear warmdown (+0.09%, within noise): warmdown shape is not a lever here (exp 3, human review)
